title: Training Note — The Carry-Over Base of a Closed OTC Quarter
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, over-the-counter allowance.** The carry-over base is the amount the carry-over share is taken of when a closed quarter's retained carry-over is worked out.

**Rule.** The carry-over base is the full amount loaded for the closed quarter where the closed quarter carries at least one mail catalog or online order and the coverage is effective 6 or more whole months before the forfeiture is booked; the purchases tagged to the closed quarter where the closed quarter carries at least one mail catalog or online order and the coverage is effective fewer than 6 whole months before; and the quarter's unused allowance where the closed quarter carries no mail catalog or online order.

### Questions and answers

*Which orders decide the base?* The purchases tagged to the closed quarter whose channel is mail catalog or online. Retail pharmacy purchases do not count as such an order.

*Which months are counted?* The whole months from the effective date of the member's pharmacy coverage to the day the forfeiture is booked.

*What is the quarter's unused allowance?* The amount loaded for the closed quarter less every purchase tagged to it, never below zero.

### Method table

| Mail catalog or online order in the closed quarter | Coverage effective 6 or more whole months before booking | Carry-over base |
|---|---|---|
| At least one | Yes | The full amount loaded for the closed quarter |
| At least one | No | The purchases tagged to the closed quarter |
| None | Yes or No | The quarter's unused allowance |

### Worked cases (hypothetical: $50.00 loaded, $40.00 of purchases, unused $10.00)

| Case | Mail catalog or online order | Coverage tenure | Carry-over base |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | One online order | 9 whole months | $50.00 |
| B | One mail catalog order | 4 whole months | $40.00 |
| C | Retail purchases only | 9 whole months | $10.00 |
